def newton_interpolation(x_nodes, y_nodes, x_eval):
    """
    Newton's form of interpolating polynomial
    P(x) = c[0] + c[1]*(x-x[0]) + c[2]*(x-x[0])*(x-x[1]) + ...

    n = len(coeffs)
    result = np.full_like(x_eval, coeffs[0], dtype=float)
